services.label: Available services
services.title: Which documents can I have legalized?
services.description: The General Secretariat of UNC offers a legalization service for documents issued by the institution for official use nationally and internationally.

s1.title: Diploma Legalization
s1.description: Official authentication of undergraduate or postgraduate diplomas issued by UNC, for use with public bodies, employers and foreign institutions.
s1.req2: Valid national ID of the holder
s1.req5: Proof of payment of the applicable fee

s2.title: Academic Certificate Legalization
s2.description: Official certification of the student's academic record, with the seal and signature of the competent institutional authority.
s2.req1: Original academic certificate issued by UNC
s2.req4: Proof of payment of the applicable fee

s3.title: Transcript Legalization
s3.description: Authentication of the official academic transcript for use in admission processes, scholarships or recognition of studies abroad.
s3.req4: Proof of payment of the applicable fee
